case_role: Separate ordinary-support composition benchmark with one finite ordinary Fixed patch and one disjoint finite normal-only Displacement patch; no per-patch force or moment target.
moment_positions: original undeformed physical native deck coordinates

physical_geometry.partition_semantics: Geometry partitions are selectable cells within two conformingly meshed material continua. No added Tie, contact, connector, interface release or extra stiffness is introduced at internal x/y seams.

ordinary_fixed_patch.native_type: ordinary Fixed on finite solid face

genuine_partial_displacement_patch.native_type: ordinary Displacement on finite solid face

unrestrained_middle_patch.meaning: No direct boundary conditions on the open middle-patch interior. Its border nodes may belong to their adjacent restrained patch boundaries, as ordinary finite-patch geometry requires.

physical_external_boundaries.physical_support_group_for_oracle: The literal union of these two disjoint ordinary physical constraint patches; exclude moving RBE references/rotation nodes and scalar-rotation auxiliary orthogonal DOF restraints.

stability_assessment.proof: For a rigid displacement u(r)=a+theta cross r, zero displacement on a finite two-dimensional patch implies theta cross v=0 for two independent in-plane separation vectors v. Therefore theta=0 and then a=0. The finite ordinary Fixed patch alone removes all six rigid motions of A; the second Ux-only patch is not needed to cure a mechanism and is a genuine distinct physical boundary.
stability_assessment.positive_elastic_material: E=20000>0 and nu=0.3 lies in the stable isotropic range.
stability_assessment.B_connection: Six strictly positive independent translational/rotational scalar connectors restrain all relative rigid motions of B's finite receiving face to A's. With connected conforming A and B continua this supplies a stable loaded small-displacement model.
stability_assessment.physical_change_from_previous_full_face_: This deliberately declared support distribution is different from a whole-face fixed RBE. Local deformation, per-patch reactions and stiffness-dependent response may change; no previous response target is copied.

moving_A.geometry: One native RBE over the union of all three coplanar A x=10 patches, y1..1.75,1.75..2.25,2.25..3 and z2..4
moving_A.kinematics: All six motions free; union deduplicates shared physical edge nodes.

moving_B.geometry: B x=20 full finite face y1..3,z2..4

moving_receiving_regions_and_connectors.motion_duty: Demonstrate actual finite-face X translation and X rotation at both moving receivers. Exact displacement magnitudes, transverse/bending response and per-patch tractions are stiffness-dependent, not statics oracle targets.

independently_known_wrenches.per_patch_wrench_oracles: None. Fx sharing and individual moments/tractions are stiffness-dependent. Only the aggregate physical ordinary-support wrench is prescribed by statics.

actual_deck_and_geometry_preconditions: Resolve the two physical ordinary constraints to finite x0 patch node sets in the stated y ranges. Their node sets and constrained node/DOF pairs must be disjoint across the 0.5 mm middle gap.

Ordinary Fixed prescribes physical translations1/2/3 only. Partial Displacement prescribes Ux only; Uy/Uz must actually be free. Do not add physical rotational SPCs to solid nodes or create a replacement external RBE.

No directly prescribed physical node/DOF may belong to either moving receiving region, either x5/x25 cut, or a connector reference/rotation node. Do not count scalar-rotation auxiliary orthogonal DOF restraints as physical external supports.
The A moving RBE union must cover exactly the three x10 end patches, total area4 mm2, centroid(10,2,3), with shared edge nodes deduplicated and no accidental interior-y face selection.

The retained A-right accounting body is the union of all three x5..10 cells; its cut is only the union of their coplanar x5 faces, total area4 mm2 and outward normal-X. Deduplicate shared cut nodes; do not double-count elements, facets or include internal-y seams as cuts.
The retained B-left body remains x20..25 with x25 cut area4 mm2 and outward normal+X.

All cell interfaces must be conformingly meshed with shared physical nodes, yielding exactly two deformable connected beam components before connector links, not six/eight mechanically disconnected cell bodies and not a mesh merge between the separated beams.
All nonzero actual CLOAD entries must lie on B's external x30 end face/edges and belong only to its right-side owner. No cut-boundary applied point load or overlapping ownership may be introduced.

Explicitly bind native physical-support outputs to both ordinary constraints and compare their summed original-origin wrench against the aggregate target. Do not require or fit each patch to a chosen force/moment split.

fixed_acceptance_and_limitations.separated_reference_transverse_couple: Preserve and assess any (rA-rB) cross fA=(0,10*Tz,-10*Ty). Do not silently force cancellation or fit a correction; this case does not qualify generally loaded noncentral transverse scalar connectors.
fixed_acceptance_and_limitations.application_lifecycle_or_cold_reopen_acc: Not established by this statics declaration.
fixed_acceptance_and_limitations.original_longitudinal_sideface_case: Unchanged historical case; this new case must not replace or claim passing its cut-node point-load refusal.
